blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Two soldiers who were wounded in a recent clash with a lawless armed group in Sultan Kudarat province were honored for courageously performing their duties. Brig. Gen. Ricky Bunayog, commander of the Army’s 6th Infantry Division and Joint Task Force Central, awarded the Wounded Personnel Medals to Sgt. George Tusan and Cpl. Gexter Quinco, both of the 23rd Mechanized Infantry Company, 2nd Mechanized Infantry Battalion, Armor Division, Philippine Army. Bunayog awarded the medals and gave them cash assistance during his visit to Camp Siongco Station Hospital in Maguindanao del Norte on Monday, Oct. 19. READ: Soldiers wounded in Negros clashes […]...
